title: Get started: Account (Open your Vantage account.)

f2.default: Four steps from sign-up to a funded account. Exact screens differ a little by country.

f5.default: Go to the Open Live Account page using our link, choose an Individual account, then enter your country, email, phone number and a password. This creates your Vantage Client Portal login.

f8.default: Complete your profile and upload a photo ID and proof of address. This is a standard anti-money-laundering (KYC) check. Review usually takes up to one business day, and Vantage emails you when you’re approved.

f11.default: When you set up your trading account, pick the platform (MetaTrader 4 or MetaTrader 5), the account type and your base currency. Not sure? MT5 is the newer platform; either works for gold, silver and crypto.

f14.default: Once approved, deposit from the Client Portal. Start with an amount you can afford to lose, or open a demo account first and practise without real money.
